deadline_semantics: Original per-profile acquisition stop boundary persists across stages and resume. Inflight bounded native work reaches safe cleanup; any overrun is retained, never excluded from project time. Setup/build and CI queues remain counted in the project ledger.

resource_contract.envelope: max sampled large-file controller RSS across all accepted formal+independent cycles minus min sampled small-file controller RSS; no division by repetition count
resource_contract.required_stability: controller sampled RSS range for each registered scenario <=8MiB across the four formal and two independent fresh-process cycles; operational repeatability screen, not a population confidence interval
resource_contract.target_scope: Source-audited streamed path, observed8MiB..128MiB range; sampled RSS, no instantaneous peak or universal asymptotic claim
resource_contract.native_engine: Report its independent RSS/CPU curve; no invented upstream efficiency threshold

latency.role: Descriptive absolute latency/CPU and operational variation, no baseline speedup or latency pass target

preparation.correctness: Four real workloads, complete bytes/state/normal tree exit
preparation.calibration: 1000 read-cost snapshots, monotonic clock,16MiB touched-memory units, CPU monotonicity,12 balanced short/long controls
preparation.pretrial: Two opposite complete orders,8 fresh controllers+engines,8/8 VALID in49.166s; observed max full case6.9003s
preparation.reuse_scope: N4 adds role/config/source validation and complete-group recording outside measurement. Rust workload, timing boundaries, sampling loop, metric reads and quality thresholds remain unchanged. Confirm updated collector dependencies before formal.
preparation.v2: Each actual CI profile completes two opposite full pretrial orders using exact frozen source inputs before formal acquisition; prep is not formal evidence.
preparation.v3: Repeat calibration and two opposite full actual pretrial orders on each actual profile; v2 pretrial and accepted groups are not v3 samples.
preparation.v4: New counter/timer calibration and8actualfresh pretrial cases per actual profile before complete new formal and independent acquisition.
preparation.v5: Full actual8case opposite-order native pretrial on each profile validates diagnostic recording before new formal acquisition.
preparation.v13: Repeat actual source-bound calibration and two opposite complete pretrial orders on each profile before v13 formal and independent acquisition; earlier source data remains historical.
preparation.v14: Each actual profile repeats source-bound calibration and two complete opposite-order pretrials before v14 formal and independent acquisition. All earlier-source attempts remain historical.
preparation.v15: Each actual profile repeats source-bound calibration and both complete opposite-order pretrials before v15 formal and independent acquisition. Diagnostic failure recording is verified separately; earlier attempts retain their original strict results.
preparation.v16: Each actual profile repeats source-bound calibration and both complete opposite-order pretrials before v16 formal and independent acquisition. Previous-source attempts stay historical.
preparation.v17: Each actual profile repeats source-bound clock/counter/native-wait calibration and both complete opposite-order pretrials before v17 formal and independent acquisition. Local prototype and prior-source attempts are not formal members.
preparation.v18: All eight native-correct/source-bound/calibrated cases execute in the original two opposite orders. At least one entire VALID order establishes readiness; the other order may retain INSUFFICIENT cases but never native/source/counter/acquisition errors. No preparation data enters formal groups. Formal coverage, every quality/resource criterion, deadlines and attempt limits unchanged.

retention: All attempts including insufficient/slow/error records retained. Only immutable complete original-order groups accepted. ERROR stops; insufficient retries original cycle without resetting deadline or counts.

revision.retained: All previous datasets and original attempts/deadlines remain historical, not members of this source protocol. No project budget or prior overrun is reset.
revision.changes: Native SOCKS5 preference now validates the host:port authority required by v2.33.2; owned direct-core startup reads the same persisted selection and passes ALL_PROXY/ALL_PROXY_NO_FALLBACK only to its child. Resource workloads, observer, counters, timing boundaries, all thresholds, complete orders, quotas, deadlines and attempt limits are unchanged. Each actual profile repeats source-bound preparation before new v21 formal/independent acquisition; all v20 results retain their original historical identity.
revision.unchanged: Measured workloads, repeat counts, timing boundaries, native byte/state/exit checks, all quality/memory/stability thresholds and four formal plus two independent fresh-process cycles.
revision.diagnostic_policy: Initial unobserved previous durations are null; diagnostics never replace required counters or become new acceptance gates.

observer_policy.darwin: Request QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE0x21 only on the short-lived observer thread after the real controller and engine are ready; retain exact requested/observed class and policy name. No worker or global priority changes.
observer_policy.scope: Measurement observer, not library runtime; no timing-quality relaxation or scheduling guarantee.

raw_observation_recording.overflow: ERROR; preserve existing raw prefix; never drop observations
raw_observation_recording.persistence: all retained rows encoded UTF-8 LF, flushed and fsynced after owned worker cleanup

timer_policy.darwin: One absolute Mach wait per observation; query native numer/denom, round interval up to ticks, retain actual ratio/period; advance missed deadlines without spinning, retrying a failure or manufacturing rows. No native worker, process/global scheduling or priority change.
timer_policy.calibration: Two sleep controls and two native-deadline windows in original balanced order; all actual intervals and native conversion retained. Private old-kqueue/new-Mach ABBA is calibration only.
timer_policy.limits: No scheduling guarantee, jitter exclusion, changed timestamps or relaxed quality limits.
